title: Distribution-free screening of spatially variable genes in spatial transcriptomics (MM-test)
stated_open_problems: Extensions to histology-derived auxiliary information and multi-omics; domain-marker FDR via knockoffs because two-step cluster-then-DE gives invalid p-values (double dipping)

title: Multi-scale spatial testing recovers gene programs missed by existing detection methods
sections_read: Results (null calibration), Discussion incl. limitations (full text)
stated_open_problems: Two-parameter moment matching cannot capture tail of zero-inflated projections (saddlepoint suggested); correlated RFF features need kurtosis-corrected Satterthwaite; non-Gaussian spectral kernels' null adaptation open; 3D untested

title: Statistical identification of cell type-specific spatially variable genes in spatial transcriptomics (Celina)
sections_read: Results (null simulations), Discussion incl. limitations (full text)
stated_open_problems: Power depends on deconvolution accuracy (true > CARD > RCTD); count modelling vs numerical stability; coordinate scaling distorts correlation at extreme aspect ratios; CSIDE p-values inflated (genomic inflation 1.2-4.1)

title: Synthetic control removes spurious discoveries from double dipping in single-cell and spatial transcriptomics (ClusterDE)
stated_open_problems: Null model assumes a single homogeneous domain; improving power while controlling FDR is future research; no method previously for double-dipping in spatial domain annotation

title: Practical limitations for real-life application of data fission and data thinning in post-clustering differential analysis
stated_open_problems: Homogeneous-distribution assumption implies no true clusters; mixture models needed but require known mixture structure; NB thinning is univariate and ignores gene correlation

title: Impact and correction of segmentation errors in spatial transcriptomics
authors: Mitchel et al. (per citation in Nat Methods Xenium paper)
stated_open_problems: Perfect segmentation will remain elusive; residual admixture is rediscovered by powered tests; downstream analysis methods should explicitly control for segmentation errors

title: MisTIC: Missegmented Transcript Inference Correction
stated_open_problems: Depends on quality of initial cell boundaries; segmentation algorithms give no confidence in masks or fraction of misassigned transcripts; extension to 3D

title: Unlocking Multi-Sample Differential Expression for Spatial Transcriptomics Data with TESSERA
stated_open_problems: Empirical (non-theoretical) null shared across genes needed for Type I control; claims first multi-sample extension; applications beyond genomics expected

title: A comparative study of statistical methods for identifying differentially expressed genes in spatial transcriptomics (GEE)
stated_open_problems: Robustness of GEE vs Wilcoxon across other ST technologies untested; Wilcoxon inflated under strong spatial correlation

title: Differential gene expression analysis of spatial transcriptomic experiments using spatial mixed models
stated_open_problems: Non-spatial tests underestimate variance (small p-values); spatial LMMs with covariance structure reduce inflation

title: Performance of deep learning methods for spatial gene expression prediction from histology images: a comprehensive assessment
stated_open_problems: Average per-gene PCC only 0.1-0.3; predictability of a gene non-uniform; targeted gene subsets suggested; new Moran-inspired spatial metric introduced

title: Benchmarking the translational potential of spatial gene expression prediction from histology
stated_open_problems: No method integrates H&E QC; gene properties conducive to prediction need investigation; transfer across resolutions; subcellular platforms (Xenium) not exploited

title: Benchmarking Active Spot Selection for Cost-Efficient Spatial Transcriptomics
stated_open_problems: Comparisons descriptive (four overlapping folds, one seed); PCC/ARI reversal on HER2+ does not replicate on cSCC; need separate pointwise and spatial measures; no inference separating acquisition from training variation

title: FlashDeconv: atlas-scale multi-resolution spatial deconvolution via structure-preserving sketching
stated_open_problems: Reference incompleteness biases deconvolution; platform mismatch across batches; resolution horizon (8-16 um) is empirical

title: Differential expression analysis for spatially correlated data using smiDE

stated_open_problems: Spatial confounding when covariate (niche/cell type) is spatially structured; joint multi-sample spatial models are the next step; covariate adjustment and gene filtering for misassignment are heuristic

title: Systematic benchmarking of computational methods to identify spatially variable genes
stated_open_problems: Most methods produce poorly calibrated p-values (authors recommend rank thresholds); pre-selection of genes may bias benchmark; spatial ATAC methods lacking

title: Mapping disease critical spatially variable gene programs (Spacelink)
